blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan cited the need to address delays in the justice system of the country as he called for the full funding of the Judiciary’s proposed P84.13-billion budget for 2027 on Friday. Pangilinan, who presented the Judiciary’s proposed 2027 budget, said during the Senate’s budget deliberations that the agency needs adequate funding to address case backlogs, expand free legal assistance, strengthen judicial accountability, and improve court facilities and security.
